messages:
Maria_CS: Quick FYI — AcmeOps renewal (10 seats) incoming. They want to move 10 seats to a new EU subsidiary but keep the same PO and pricing. Also requesting 9‑month term and Docusign routing to be changed to their AP inbox.
Sam_Sales: Do we allow seat transfers to a different billing entity without a new PO? vendor code?
Jordan_SE: Onboarding note — swapping seats mid-term may require a short re‑onboarding window for the new users. Recommend a 2‑week cutover and a 1‑seat grace for training.
Dana_Fin: We can keep same PO if finance confirms vendor code + tax entity. Net30 still ok, but EU entity needs VAT handling. Please share the new legal entity name + tax id.
Maria_CS: New entity: AcmeOps EU Ltd, VAT GB123456789. PO stays as PO-99887 per customer. Doc link: https://redwood-internal/acme/renewals/1766612345
Legal_Bot: flag: routing change requires updated signature authority. Snippet to add:
```
Signer must be an authorized officer of the billing entity specified on the PO. Any change of billing entity requires an executed amendment.
```
Sam_Sales: Can we do a minor amendment (no price change) and append to existing contract? Customer wants to avoid new PO.
Dana_Fin: Yes — if VAT + entity validated, finance can invoice original PO but will need intercompany mapping. I'll create a PO exception ticket and assign to ops.
Jordan_SE: Operational ask: suggest we schedule a 30min handoff with their IT to confirm user provisioning. I can join Wed AM.
Maria_CS: I'll request Docusign routing update and prepare amendment draft. @Dana_Fin can you confirm vendor code by EOD? :thumbsup:
Dana_Fin: Confirmed vendor code = ACME-EU-042. I'll open ticket and loop legal.
Legal_Bot: Added amendment template to the thread. Once signed, update Contract ID to include amendment suffix.
Maria_CS: Great — I'll patch renewal timeline: aiming for signed amendment by next Fri, onboarding cutover week after. Thanks all. :pray:
